notes.title: Development Status: Project Canceled
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42154421/3dcfb7c407c7bc0b51186c511cdf6b361d6ef90e.jpg[/img]
Due to limited community interest, the development of this title has been canceled. While we saw potential in the concept, we’ve ultimately decided to focus our efforts on other projects that better align with player expectations.

We’ve added this note to remain transparent and fair to our community. Thank you for your support and for following the project.
